title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Sleepover This service provides participant assistance with personal tasks of daily life where overnight support is needed, but the caregiver can sleep when not required to provide support. This support applies to any day of the week and on public holidays. Night-time Sleepover Supports must meet these conditions: The support begins before midnight to 06:00 the next day, lasting for a minimum continuous period of 8 hours. The support worker can sleep during times when their help is not required. Our overnight sleepover includes Meal Preparation Helping the participant prepare meals, ensuring they have a nutritious and enjoyable dinner. Bedtime Assistance Aiding the participant in getting ready for bed, which may include personal care routines. On-Call Support The support worker/ registered nurse remains ‘on call’ throughout the night. They can assist with tasks as needed, like toileting, managing medication, or responding to emergencies. Same as On-call overnight Monitoring
